messages:
sophie: Quick pass on the ember-slate dark mock. Two main nits: chart fills wash out at small sizes and inline code blocks float against the card. Screenshot: https://img.mock/ember-slate.png :mag:
eren: Noted. Tiny sparklines lose definition. Suggest adding a 1px stroke on lines and slightly lighten the area fill. Current gradient midpoint at 50% feels too heavy.
mike: For code blocks the bg is almost identical to the panel; readers miss backticks. Proposal: code-bg #0d1722, code-text #eaf6ff, padding 12px. That should hit AA at small sizes.
sophie: Copy nit: theme toggle tooltip reads "Low-power mode" which is confusing. Change to "Toggle light/dark theme" and surface a separate "Reduce motion" control in Accessibility.
eren: Also: propose an Accessibility switch called "Chart clarity (high contrast)" under Settings -> Accessibility, default off. Good for demos and a11y checks.
design-bot: Opened PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/console/pull/624 with ember-slate vars + code padding. CI: 1 visual snapshot diff (charts).
mike: Quick experiment: shift gradient midpoint to 30% and desaturate fills by 8%. I'll add a story in storybook and run a visual diff.
sophie: Action items: mike prototype gradient change; eren wire in accessibility toggle; mike update code CSS; sophie to run contrast audit after PR lands. Target: staging tomorrow. :calendar:
